summary: Adds AI onboarding routing for all commands, including the `--ai-onboard` shortcut, while preserving the shared command and onboarding code paths.
highlights: Global `--ai-onboard` routing now maps any command into the existing onboarding docs
`obs`, `analyze`, and other command families share the same onboarding code paths
Permission guardrails for `config grant` remain explicit in onboarding output
Release metadata, onboarding docs, and update manifest now point at v1.1.9
update_instructions: Download the latest release from the GitHub releases page or rerun the install script from download.reservecli.dev.
